description: South Africa - Electricity Transmission and Distribution is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Energy access, Transmission and distribution", published or maintained by Christopher Arderne (World Bank Group). Transmission network for South Africa, including some lines down to 44 and 88 kV. Does not include any planned lines. Data is from a March 2017 extract from OpenStreetMap. All data © OpenStreetMap contributors. Coverage: South Africa. It has 2 files in GeoJSON, ZIP. The portal files it under Energy access, Transmission and distribution. The portal gives 2017 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support power-system and electrification planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
